1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perkhidmatan Kewangan
(Pengecualian) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Mac 2023 hingga 30 Jun 2027.

Pengecualian

2. Menteri mengecualikan Bank Pembangunan Malaysia Berhad  daripada
pemakaian perenggan 8(1)(a) Akta bagi maksud menjalankan perniagaan insurans
jaminan kewangan  yang dipindahkan daripada Danajamin Nasional Berhad
kepada Bank Pembangunan Malaysia Berhad sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual
bagi tempoh mulai 1 Mac 2023 hingga 30 Jun 2027.

FINANCIAL SERVICES ACT 2013

FINANCIAL SERVICES (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 63 of the
Financial Services Act 2013 [Act 758], the Minister, on the recommendation of the Bank,
makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may  be cited as the Financial Services (Exemption)
Order 2023.

(2) This Order has effect from 1 March 2023 to 30 June 2027.

Exemption
2. The Minister exempts Bank Pembangunan Malaysia Berhad  from
the application of paragraph 8(1)(a) of the Act for the purpose  of carrying on
the financial guarantee insurance business transferred from Danajamin Nasional Berhad
to Bank Pembangunan Malaysia Berhad as specified in the Schedule for  the period
from 1 March 2023 to 30 June 2027.
